report_narrative: One of five planned observations is present, two are absent, one is indeterminate, and one is not applicable. The supported pattern warrants a targeted inquiry; no indicator establishes criminal conduct.

The review covers five planned indicator observations and their explicit applicability tests. The fictional thresholds support reproducible method checks; they are not universal reporting or risk-acceptance criteria.
RF-F01: A has a 95.0% outward-to-inward ratio within two hours, but the distinct-payer indicator is absent.
RF-F02: C is reported to have three payments, but no original ledger or event times are supplied.
RF-F03: B is excluded from RF-01 on confirmed ownership; D does not meet the three-payee criterion.

Of five observations, one is present, two absent, one indeterminate and one not applicable. Known gross movement is $27,500.00. These states retain separate denominators, and the amount is not a measure of illicit proceeds.

The present pattern supports a targeted inquiry alongside the documented competing explanation. Missing evidence leaves one observation indeterminate; lack of applicability is not a favorable test result.

File 10 supplies the complete synthetic observations, case hypotheses and evidence IDs. Public typology sources inform the review vocabulary, while their indicator descriptions do not establish subject-specific facts.

Seek the evidence that distinguishes the competing hypotheses and resolves the indeterminate observation. Escalate only through the authorized review process; retain all absent and inapplicable observations in the population.
